# olivares_budgets (Data Source)

Reads the FinOps spend budgets in the Olivares AI control plane (read-only). Requires finops:budget:read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "olivares_budgets" "all" {}

output "total_monthly_cap_usd" {
  value = sum([for b in data.olivares_budgets.all.budgets : b.limit_micro_usd / 1000000 if b.period == "monthly"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant` (String) Tenant UUID, overriding the provider-level tenant. Sent as X-Olivares-Tenant.

### Read-Only

- `budgets` (Attributes List) The declared budgets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--budgets))

<a id="nestedatt--budgets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `budgets`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Enforcement action: alert | throttle | block.
- `currency` (String) Reporting currency label.
- `dimension` (String) Spend dimension scoped on.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the budget is active.
- `id` (String) Budget ID.
- `key` (String) Dimension key (empty for global).
- `limit_micro_usd` (Number) Spend cap for the period, in micro-USD.
- `name` (String) Budget name.
- `period` (String) Reset period.
- `reserved_micro_usd` (Number) Reserved/committed capacity counted toward the limit.
- `thresholds` (List of Number) Fractional alert thresholds.
